definitions.gloss: lucky charm; good-luck item; talisman; auspicious object
definitions.explanation: An object believed to bring good fortune. In Japanese culture, this includes items like daruma dolls, beckoning cats (maneki-neko), and certain foods served at New Year.

examples.japanese: だるまは{縁起物|えんぎもの}だ。
お{正月|しょうがつ}には{縁起物|えんぎもの}を{飾|かざ}る{習慣|しゅうかん}がある。
examples.english: There is a custom of displaying lucky items at New Year.

examples.japanese: {受験生|じゅけんせい}に{縁起物|えんぎもの}のお{菓子|かし}をプレゼントした。
examples.english: I gave the exam student a good-luck candy as a gift.

notes:
USAGE:
Japanese culture has many {縁起物|えんぎもの}, including {招|まね}き{猫|ねこ} (beckoning cat), だるま (daruma doll), {熊手|くまで} (bamboo rake — for raking in good fortune), and certain New Year foods. During exam season, snacks with names that sound like "pass" ({勝|か}つ, etc.) are also sold as {縁起物|えんぎもの}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縁起物|えんぎもの}を{飾|かざ}る (to display a lucky charm)
- {縁起物|えんぎもの}を{贈|おく}る (to give a good-luck item as a gift)
